rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement structure and contents from their own plumbing failure is direct property damage to the home, covered under the homeowners policy.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement flooded due to plumbing failure while claimant was away on work trip. Two inches of water caused buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall to one foot, and destroyed stored boxes. High-severity damage estimated well above $25,000; water extraction and mold assessment needed urgently.

case_facts.description: approximately two inches of water across entire basement; hardwood floor buckled; drywall soaked to about one foot high; stored boxes ruined
case_facts.discovery_context: claimant returned from work trip to find basement flooded

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is standard property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Wind damage claim from POL-1006. Four shingles blown off back porch overhang with no interior water damage. Estimated repair cost $400, well below deductible of $2,500. Low-severity claim.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind, no interior water damage
